links.outcome: Patient disclosure of LLM use to clinicians and concerns about accuracy
links.effect: 93.8% of LLM users did not disclose use to clinicians; 82.7% had accuracy concerns; 32.7% mostly or completely distrusted LLM information; 56.2% believed clinicians should be aware.
links.quote: Most users (93.8%) did not disclose LLM use, although 56.2% believed clinicians should be aware.

links.outcome: Patient use of consumer LLM chatbots for health information before clinic visit
links.effect: 71.2% reported prior LLM use, and 28.6% used an LLM to learn about their condition before the visit; 93.8% did not disclose it to clinicians.
links.quote: Among 59 respondents (mean age 50.1 years; 53.4% female), 71.2% reported prior LLM use, and 28.6% used an LLM to learn about their condition before the visit.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey evaluating real-world patient use, trust, perceptions, and disclosure of LLMs for health information in an otolaryngology clinic.
